mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_assist_snapshot WHERE email = #{email} AND baby_no = #{babyNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_assist_snapshot (email, baby_no, item_id, category, title, summary, link, status, source) VALUES (#{email}, #{babyNo}, #{itemId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{link}, #{status}, #{source})
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_no, email, baby_no, item_id, category, title, summary, link, status, source, updated_at FROM tbl_assist_snapshot WHERE email = #{email} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, snapshot_no DESC
mapper.update: ALTER TABLE tbl_assist_region ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS baby_months INT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_assist_region (email, region_sido, region_sigungu, baby_months) VALUES (#{email}, #{regionSido}, #{regionSigungu}, #{babyMonths}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE region_sido = #{regionSido}, region_sigungu = #{regionSigungu}, baby_months = #{babyMonths}
